_comment: Merge these four keys into corpus/reference_vectors.json's existing 'expected' object. Same inputs_hex order as the existing file. Computed from the exact C semantics in the new .c sources (crc=0xFFFFFFFF init, final ~crc for crc32c, no final invert for jamcrc, multiply-then-xor for fnv1_32, Bernstein sdbm recurrence) and cross-checked against the published check values V2_SPEC.md section 5.2 already states (JAMCRC('123456789')=340bc6d9, CRC-32C('123456789')=e3069283, FNV-1_32('a')=050c5d7e) -- all three matched exactly. sdbm has no published check value in the spec; these are from a single implementation only, not yet cross-checked (see PHASE_D_HANDOFF.md).
